trust_decision.summary: Whether a CP user may read a nav's pages and the data of an entry referenced by a nav page is decided by the NavTreePolicy/NavPolicy 'view' and EntryPolicy 'view' gates, which the nav pages controller never called before the fix.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'navigation endpoint ... disclosure of restricted entries'; the create action loads an arbitrary entry from ?entry= and returns its values as originValues with no gate.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET cp/navigation/{navigation}/pages/create (routes/cp.php:141), nav tree view check
GET cp/navigation/{navigation}/pages/{edit}/edit (routes/cp.php:142), entry view check on the stored branch reference
POST cp/navigation/{navigation}/pages (routes/cp.php:140), validate-only action, nav view check

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Http/Controllers/CP/Navigation/NavigationPagesController.php:53-58 reads an entry reference persisted in the nav tree by src/Http/Controllers/CP/Navigation/NavigationTreeController.php:77-83 (tree update stores branch['entry'] with only an 'edit nav' gate at :42, no entry view check)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The edit action only reads pages already in the tree, so a solver who fixed the ?entry= create path can argue stored references were placed by an authorised editor; and the update action 'doesn't actually update' (comment at NavigationPagesController.php:152-156), so it looks harmless to leave ungated.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A user with 'view {nav} nav' plus view permission on the entry's collection must still get originValues/syncableFields for entry-linked pages, and URL-only pages (no entry) must still open; an over-broad fix that demands entry 'edit', or 'edit nav' for viewing, or that blanks originValues, breaks the page editor (fix.diff:121-166, fix.diff:249-301).

O6_input_shapes: entry ID supplied directly as the ?entry= query parameter on create (NavigationPagesController.php:25)
entry ID read from a persisted tree branch on edit (NavigationPagesController.php:53-57)
entry data leaking through merged page values, not only originValues: getPageValues merges entry data into 'values' (NavigationPagesController.php:124-135)
nav addressed per-site via request 'site' (tree policy) vs whole nav (NavPolicy on update)

O7_producer.where: src/Http/Controllers/CP/Navigation/NavigationPagesController.php:124-150 (getPageValues/getEntryValues merge entry and origin data into the page 'values' and 'originValues'); src/Structures/TreeBuilder.php:88-118 (transformTreeForController emits entry_title, url, status, redirect)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET cp/navigation/{navigation}/tree returns every page of any nav, including referenced entries' title, url, status, redirect and blueprint, with no nav or entry view gate
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the tree listing, not the page editor endpoint the report names; its data feeds the nav show page which is gated at NavigationController.php:85, so a solver can argue the tree is only reachable after that check.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same directory, separate controller; data producer in src/Structures/TreeBuilder.php:88-118

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Tree output for a viewable nav still exposes entries the user cannot view (entry_title, url, status) because TreeBuilder never checks entry view, unlike can_delete which it does check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Nav viewers are expected to see the nav's structure; per-entry filtering looks like a feature change rather than a fix.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: tree update accepts branch['entry'] for any entry ID without an entry view check, so a nav editor can attach a hidden entry and read it back
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The update path only gates 'edit nav' at :42; a maintainer treats the entry ID as an opaque reference picked from the UI selector.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getSyncableFields reveals the entry blueprint's field handles; a planted variant returning entry values there would bypass a check placed only around originValues
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Helper is called in the return array after the gated block, and a maintainer could expand it for the sync UI.

O9_family: missing authorization / IDOR on CP read endpoints (CWE-862, CWE-639)

O10_build.toolchain: composer + phpunit with Orchestra Testbench (Laravel package)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add $this->authorize('view', $entry) only in create() around the ?entry= lookup, leaving edit(), update() and the tree index ungated.

out_of_scope_notes: CollectionTreeController::index (src/Http/Controllers/CP/Collections/CollectionTreeController.php:17-28) also builds a tree via TreeBuilder with no collection view gate; collection permission, not nav, so not pursued.
Relationship fieldtype endpoints (routes/cp.php:307-309) return entry data for pickers; separate feature, possibly one of the sibling advisories.
